bubbleSort.title: Bubble Sort Visualization
bubbleSort.subtitle: Learn how bubble sort algorithm works step by step

explanation.title: How Bubble Sort Works
explanation.step1: Compare adjacent elements in the array
explanation.step2: If the left element is greater than the right element, swap them
explanation.step3: Continue this process for the entire array
explanation.step4: Repeat until no more swaps are needed
explanation.bestCase: Best case: O(n) - when array is already sorted
explanation.worstCase: Worst case: O(n²) - when array is reverse sorted

compareSort.title: Sorting Algorithms Comparison
compareSort.subtitle: Compare the performance of different sorting algorithms side by side

explanation.title: Algorithm Explanations
explanation.bubbleDesc: Repeatedly steps through the list, compares adjacent elements and swaps them if they are in the wrong order.
explanation.quickDesc: Picks a 'pivot' element and partitions the array around the pivot, then recursively sorts the sub-arrays.
explanation.insertionDesc: Builds the final sorted array one item at a time by inserting each element into its proper position.

fibonacci.title: Fibonacci Sequence Recursion
fibonacci.subtitle: Visualize how recursive calls work in calculating Fibonacci numbers

sequence.title: Fibonacci Sequence
sequence.description: The sequence where each number is the sum of the two preceding ones

explanation.title: How Fibonacci Recursion Works
explanation.step1: 1. Check if n is 0 or 1 (base cases)
explanation.step2: 2. If not, recursively call F(n-1) and F(n-2)
explanation.step3: 3. Add the results of both recursive calls
explanation.timeDesc: Time: Exponential growth due to repeated calculations
explanation.spaceDesc: Space: Linear due to call stack depth
explanation.optimizationDesc: This naive approach has exponential time complexity. Dynamic programming or memoization can reduce it to O(n).

hanoi.title: Tower of Hanoi Algorithm
hanoi.subtitle: Learn the classic recursive algorithm through animated visualization

explanation.title: Algorithm Explanation
explanation.rule1: Only move one disk at a time
explanation.rule2: Only move the top disk from a stack
explanation.rule3: Never place a larger disk on a smaller one
explanation.step1: Move n-1 disks from source to auxiliary tower
explanation.step2: Move the largest disk from source to destination
explanation.step3: Move n-1 disks from auxiliary to destination tower
explanation.complexityDesc: Moving n disks requires 2^n-1 moves, time complexity is O(2^n)
